subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should shipped `nativeBaseUrl` configurations retain native `/v1/inference` semantics, or may this release reinterpret them as aliases for the OpenAI-compatible base URL?
rationale: Both endpoints are legitimate but different provider contracts, and source inspection cannot determine whether breaking custom native endpoints is an intentional product decision.

options.title: Preserve native semantics
options.body: Keep `nativeBaseUrl` on the prior native request path while using the OpenAI videos API for the default and `baseUrl` paths, with upgrade regression coverage.

options.title: Retire the native contract
options.body: Intentionally remove or migrate `nativeBaseUrl` with an explicit diagnostic or doctor path, documentation, and proof that the resulting upgrade break is accepted.

recommendation.title: Preserve native semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `nativeBaseUrl` on the prior native request path while using the OpenAI videos API for the default and `baseUrl` paths, with upgrade regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and continue to own the DeepInfra provider behavior, making them the strongest available routing candidate for clarifying the intended contract before an official maintainer approves it.
